Calendar time of a given number of events

Source: R/EventTime.R
EventTime.Rd

Returns, for each simulated trial, the calendar time at which the given number of observed PFS or OS events is reached. Events censored by dropout are not counted. The result can be passed to CutoffData for event-driven analyses.

Usage

EventTime(data, events, endpoint = c("os", "pfs"))

Arguments

data

A data frame returned by rOncoEndpoints.

events

Number of events.

endpoint

"os" or "pfs".

Value

A numeric vector with one value per simulated trial (NA when fewer events occur), named by sim.

Examples

arm <- OncoArm(pfs.median = 6, orr = 0.3, resp.cor = 0.4, death.prop = 0.15,
               os.median = 15)
dat <- rOncoEndpoints(nsim = 3, n = 200, arms = arm, a.time = c(0, 12),
                      seed = 1)
EventTime(dat, events = 100, endpoint = "os")
#>        1        2        3 
#> 22.26770 20.44160 21.58353
